title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Effective date: 15 October 2025. Domains covered: alnajjroffer.com, alnajjarfirm.com. Contact: info@alnajjarfirm.com | +961 81 623 936 | Awkar - Haret El Ballan, Lebanon.

policySections.title: Who we are
policySections.text: Al Najjar Firm provides marketing strategy, creative production, performance services, and related consulting.

policySections.title: Personal data we collect
policySections.text: You provide data such as name, email, phone, company, billing details, messages, and files. We also collect technical data automatically, including IP, device/browser details, viewed pages, referrers, timestamps, and approximate location. If connected, we may receive data from analytics/ads platforms, payment processors, and scheduling tools.

policySections.title: How we use your data
policySections.text: We use data to provide and improve services, respond to inquiries and support, send administrative or marketing communications, analyze usage, prevent fraud/abuse, and comply with legal obligations.

policySections.title: Legal bases
policySections.text: Where applicable, processing is based on consent, contract necessity, legitimate interests, and legal obligation.

policySections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
policySections.text: We use essential cookies for operation and optional cookies for analytics/advertising. You can manage preferences in your browser and via cookie tools where available. Blocking some cookies may affect functionality.

policySections.title: Analytics and advertising partners
policySections.text: We may use tools such as Google Analytics and Meta/LinkedIn/TikTok pixels to measure performance and run campaigns. These providers may process data under their own policies.

policySections.title: Sharing your data
policySections.text: We may share data with service providers/processors, in business transfers, and when required for legal compliance, rights protection, or fraud/security prevention.

policySections.title: International transfers
policySections.text: Data may be stored or processed outside Lebanon. We apply reasonable safeguards during transfers, including contractual protections where relevant.

policySections.title: Data retention
policySections.text: Data is kept only as long as necessary, then deleted or anonymized. Typical retention includes inquiry data up to 24 months, client/project records for engagement duration plus up to 7 years, and analytics based on tool settings.

policySections.title: Your rights
policySections.text: Subject to local law, you may request access, correction, deletion, objection or limitation, and portability. Contact info@alnajjarfirm.com. Identity verification may be required.

policySections.title: Marketing communications
policySections.text: You can unsubscribe from marketing messages via email footer links or by contacting us. Transactional/service messages may still be sent when needed.

policySections.title: Security
policySections.text: We apply reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards. No system is fully secure; please share only necessary information.

policySections.title: Children
policySections.text: Our sites/services are not directed to children under 13. If a child provided data, contact us and we will remove it.

policySections.title: Third-party links
policySections.text: Our sites may include links to external websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.

policySections.title: Changes to this policy
policySections.text: We may update this policy periodically. Material updates will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
